title: Beyond Pass@k: Measuring Reliability and Security of Agentic Code Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.14711v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI coding agent benchmarks rank agents with the Chen et al. (2021) pass@k estimator, but current implementations misapply it: they set n to the number of unit tests in a single submission rather than the number of independent rollout attempts, conflating test-suite size with attempt independence. We diagnose this operationalization error, prove it by counterexample, and propose reliability@k, the same estimator applied correctly, with n = independent rollouts and c = fully-passing rollouts per (task, agent) pair. In a synthetic multi-rollout benchmark, the misapplied metric inflates reported scores by 0.85-0.97 in absolute terms (0.96-0.98 reported vs. 0.00-0.12 corrected), and a cheap single-rollout proxy fails to substitute for repeated runs (Spearman $\rho = 0.417$). translated_title: 超越Pass@k：衡量智能体代码生成的可靠性与安全性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14711v1 公告类型：新论文  摘要：AI编码智能体基准测试使用Chen等人（2021）的pass@k估计器对智能体进行排名，但当前实现错误地应用了该方法：它们将n设置为单个提交中的单元测试数量，而不是独立尝试次数，从而混淆了测试套件大小与尝试独立性。我们诊断了这一操作化错误，通过反例证明了其错误性，并提出了reliability@k，即正确应用同一估计器，其中n = 独立尝试次数，c = 每个（任务，智能体）对中完全通过的尝试次数。在合成多尝试基准测试中，错误应用的指标将报告分数绝对提升了0.85-0.97（报告值0.96-0.98对比修正值0.00-0.12），而廉价的单尝试代理无法替代重复运行（Spearman ρ = 0.417）。基于功能正确性并不等同于安全性的证据，我们进一步提出了安全调整的reliability@k，该指标仅计入通过安全性检查的尝试。
tldr: 本文揭示了AI编码智能体基准测试中pass@k指标的误用问题，提出了正确应用的reliability@k和安全调整版本，以确保评估既可靠又安全。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies the misapplication of pass@k in AI coding agent benchmarks, proposes correctly applied reliability@k and a security-adjusted variant to ensure reliable and safe evaluation.
